create_action_instance: create an Action instance with a structure dict mapping field names to array indices
set_action_field: set a field value on an Action object using dictionary-style assignment
get_action_field: get a field value from an Action object using dictionary-style access
get_action_array: access the underlying numpy array of an Action object via the array attribute
get_action_length: get the total size of an Action object using the len function
